<details markdown="1">
<summary>Source review</summary>

- **Note:** Equation and printed coefficients remain source-checked, but the Table II fit is not reproduced from the available published inputs. The published fixed-V0 NaCl-B2 Vinet curve gives 0.622381 GPa pressure RMS and mean residual -0.547610 GPa on 125 DAC-2 Table S1 observations above 35 GPa; all 125 residuals are negative. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=25.447259 GPa, K0\_prime=5.582768 and RMS 0.293229 GPa, versus published 24.92 GPa and 5.63. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved; including the above-33-GPa transition rows does not restore agreement.
- **Audit date:** 2026-10-17
- **Verified fields:** equation; parameters; units; reference\_state; phase; published\_uncertainties; validity
- **Primary source check:**
    - **Access URL:** https://doi.org/10.1103/fxgq-96sg
    - **Locations:** Equation (4), page 8; Table I and footnotes, page 4; Table II, pages 9-12; Section III.E, pages 8 and 12-14; Experimental methods, page 2; Supplemental Table S1, official Excel workbook; Fratanduono et al. (2020), Table I and Supplemental Eq. (2)
    - **Finding:** The ten stored records are the Cu-anchored reduced-300 K Vinet P-V fits. V0 is fixed; the table's quoted K0 and K0' uncertainties are preserved. The official Table S1 workbook supplies the complete simultaneous unit-cell-volume dataset and its row-wise standard errors. Pressures are reproducible from same-run Cu volumes using Fratanduono et al. (2020) Supplemental Eq. (2) and the main-article Table I 298 K coefficients. The article does not state a confidence level, pressure weights, or parameter covariance, so none is inferred.
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/fxgq-96sg
- **Migration source:**
    - **Project:** Dioptas
    - **Version:** 0.10.0
    - **Commit:** 5a8bfd81d10bfab3499039603380aae34576d60a
    - **File:** nacl\_b2.json
- **Primary data check:**
    - **Status:** bundled

    - **Dataset identifiers:** shen\_smith\_2026\_table\_s1\_simultaneous\_volumes
    - **Source locations:** Supplemental Table S1 workbook, DAC-1 and DAC-2 worksheets
    - **Finding:** Published Table S1 transcription is bundled with simultaneous Cu readings and volume errors: all 194 MgO and 131 NaCl-B2 measurements are in DAC-2. This accounts for the available published volume table, not necessarily every author-held fit input. The previous workbook-to-CSV audit is preserved; a new workbook download on 2026-10-17 required authentication.
- **Recommendation date:** 2026-10-17
- **Recommendation audit:** docs/literature-reproductions/shen-smith-2026-cu-refits.md
- **Recommendation reason:** Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 NaCl-B2 Vinet curve gives 0.622381 GPa pressure RMS and mean residual -0.547610 GPa on 125 DAC-2 Table S1 observations above 35 GPa; all 125 residuals are negative. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=25.447259 GPa, K0\_prime=5.582768 and RMS 0.293229 GPa, versus published 24.92 GPa and 5.63. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved; including the above-33-GPa transition rows does not restore agreement.
- **Unresolved:** Exact author-used P-V fit table and row mask, pressure-reduction implementation, residual coordinate, weights and covariance are unavailable.; The article describes Table II as direct fits to this study's Cu-referenced data, with literature parameters for comparison, but its data-availability statement mentions additional author-held data. No extra fit observations are explicitly identified; completeness of the actual author inputs is unconfirmed.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Thermal equation choices</summary>

- **Debye temperature law:** variable\_exponent

</details>

Vinet + Mie-Grüneisen-Debye fit to room-temperature data up to 107 GPa and a 1000 K decompression series from 98 to 34 GPa; the paper's 2000 K curve is an extrapolation. The Debye temperature follows the printed variable-exponent equation; the drawn curves cannot uniquely distinguish it from the integrated law.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Independent Peritheos staged refit of digitized Fei (2007) NaCl-B2 study markers: 12 Figure 3 rows at 300 K determine K0/K0-prime with V0 fixed; then all 12 Figure 4 rows at 1000 K determine q with the cold fit frozen. The printed variable-exponent Debye law, V0, gamma0 and theta0 are inherited from the published record. Equal pressure weights are an analyst choice. Duplicate Figure 4 cold markers, other-paper comparisons and calculated curve vertices are excluded. This is a conditional figure-data refit, not reproduction of the authors' fit or independent validation of pressure accuracy. Original unrounded measurements, P/V/T errors, measured Pt cells, source weights and calibration covariance remain unavailable. Conditional stage errors are archived in fit statistics only; catalog parameter errors and covariance are unset because predictor, calibrant, fixed-anchor and inter-stage uncertainty are not propagated. Coverage consists of separate 300 and 1000 K series, not a validated P-T rectangle.
- **Reference isotherm:**
    - **V0:** Table 1 footnote: adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985), fixed.
    - **K0:** Independent unweighted pressure-residual fit of 12 Figure 3 study markers at 300 K, with V0 fixed; see fit\_provenance.
    - **K0 prime:** Same independent cold fit as K0; neither coefficient replaces the published Fei record.
- **Thermal correction:**
    - **Tr:** Equation 3 subtracts Debye energy at 300 K.
    - **Theta0:** Table 1 footnote: 290 K adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985). theta\_D=theta0\*(V/V0)^(-gamma(V)) is printed explicitly.
    - **Gamma0:** Table 1 footnote: 1.70 adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985).
    - **Q:** Independent unweighted pressure-residual fit of all 12 Figure 4 hot markers at 1000 K, freezing the preceding cold fit and adopted gamma0/theta0; see fit\_provenance.
    - **N:** Two atoms per NaCl formula unit; V0=41.35 A^3 is a one-formula-unit B2 cell.

</details>

Pt measurements bracketing each scan retain their source first/last sequence labels. Phase labels distinguish bcc-Fe from hcp-Fe and NaCl-B1 from NaCl-B2. The workbook defines the errors as standard errors combining peak-fitting standard deviations and dispersion among volumes from different (hkl) peaks. Cu reference volumes are included even though no separate Shen-Smith Cu EOS record is bundled. The complete workbook is retained rather than only the lower-scatter run subsets used for the preferred fits.
